title: Seeking from duration to start while in ended state (hevc-50fps-cbr-uhd)
product-requirement: Client must have access to expected events and properties after seeking from duration to start while MediaSource is in the ended state.
specification: Terminals MUST implement Media Source Extensions API (https://www.w3.org/TR/media-source-2/).
assertion: MediaSource and MediaElement events must emit in expected order, and properties must be of expected values.

changelog.summary: Fixed floating point precision and race condition: slow segment download speed can cause timeouts
